notes.title: Update 5 - Morbid Rebirth
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We have another exciting update for you today!

Update 5 is now live and birngs two much requested features to Morbid: The Seven Acolytes!

[u][b]Update 5 changes[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Map Feature added
[*] New Game Plus added
[/list]

[u][b]Map[/b][/u]

We know you've been wanting a map so we're very pleased to deliver it! Here's an image of what it looks like in the starting area in-game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38037977/ca3b989fa44fd32b8ed0804ad5bfc0ec847d6b5a.jpg[/img]

[u][b]New Game Plus[/b][/u]

If you have completed the core campaign of Morbid, you now have the opportunity to start New Game Plus and go back and challenge The Seven Acolytes for a new harder experience. 

The New Game Plus features consecutive additive difficulty. Each time you beat the campaign you can go back to continue to challenge them for a tougher and tougher experience!

To start New Game Plus load a save slot that has beaten the campaign and it will prompt you to find a new option in the shrine. 

[url=https://discord.gg/mergegeames]Join your fellow Strivers on Discord.[/url]

notes.title: Update 4 - The Stash!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We have a new update for you with some quality of life updates, and a much requested feature!

[b]Update 4 changes.[/b]

[list]
[*] Walk/Run Speed tweaked
[*] New tutorial pages added
[*] Minor UI improvements 
[*] Tutorial text corrections
[/list]

In addition to the above, we're pleased to add a stash to the game. The Stash is an additional storage location which can be found at the Shrines. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38037977/43a465577388e84227d424efd61ea924418577b8.jpg[/img]

This can store 132 slots worth of items so now you never have to worry about to leaving items behind. 

We're also working away on the next update which comes with some big news, so watch this space!

Join us on [url=https://discord.gg/mergegames]Discord[/url].

notes.title: Update 3!
notes.notes:
Hi all,

We have a new content update that we want to share with you which focuses on some quality of life improvements to the game. 

*Edit - updated to include Korean and Traditional Chinese language support.

Please find all the details below;

[u][b]Tutorial[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Incorrect button prompt in one of the tutorials' is fixed
[/list]
[u][b]Bosses[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Lorn's AI fixed, pathfinding fixed and hitboxes fixed
[/list]
[u][b]Font[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Total amount of fonts has been reduced from 5 to 2. This will lower the loading time between language changes by around 50%
[/list]
[u][b]Enemy[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Lorn's combo attack hitboxes are fixed
[*]FloraSoul's attack hitboxes are fixed
[/list]
[u][b]Weapon[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Fist weapons now have longer distance where they "leap" towards the enemy
[*]Mecha Gloves has been nerfed
[/list]
[u][b]Player[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]"Auto-aim" for the leaping has been adjusted. This should make you feel more in control of the player during combat.
[/list]
[u][b]Language[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Traditional Chinese added into the game 
[*]Korean was added as a supported language
[/list]
As always we hope you enjoy these updates and please do share feedback with us.

notes.title: Update 2 now live!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hi all,[/h1]

We have a content update before we wrap up for the year.

This includes one of the most requested community changes, re-bindable key mapping.

Please find full notes below:

[list][*]Grimwalds Grove area has been redesign to be more clear
[*]Korean support has been added
[*]Chinese font has been changed to make it more legible
[*]Removing individual save slots is now available in the main menu
[*]Improved menu navigation
[*]Added the ability to re-bind keys in options
[*]Various minor fixes and tweaks[/list]

Other recent improvements:
[list][*]Movement speed of character increased
[*]Running consumes less stamina
[*]Hitboxes are better balanced
[*]Changing weapon loadouts is now possible outside of inventory - Use "Q"
[*]Controller vibration can be adjusted / turned off in options[/list]

We hope that you enjoy these changes and please let us know if you have any feedback.

Happy Holidays!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38037977/b3505dce755c58041a0aa399af61fa797eb1c117.png[/img]

notes.title: A Morbid Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Hey Everyone![/h1]

We're happy to confirm we have a brand new update that has just gone live, thanks to the feedback provided by our dedicated users. You can find the full list of changes below.

[h2]Change list:[/h2]
[list][*]|PARRY| - Doing a parry attack makes the player invulnerable for the period of the attack
[*]|PARRY| - Parry engages faster
[*]|PARRY| - Parry delay after being hit / interrupted is reduced
[*]|PARRY| - A "failed" parry no longer does damage to the player
[*]|PARRY| - Blocking in a direction other than the current movement direction is now easier 
[*]|PARRY| - Blocking now faces the correct direction when playing with keyboard + mouse
[*]|PLAYER| - Moving speed ([i]walking and running[/i]) has been increased. 
[*]|PLAYER| - Running uses less stamina 
[*]|PLAYER| - Players hitbox is a bit more forgiving
[*]|PLAYER| - Changing load-outs in-game is now possible ([i]Q on keyboard, or RB/R1 on gamepad[/i])
[*]|INVENTORY| - Mouse support has been added to the inventory
[*]|OPTIONS| - Added option for changing the strength of the gamepad vibration[/list]

Thank you to those who has raised these issues and brought them to our attention. We hope these changes improve your Morbid experience.

Enjoy!
